t: Ronseal Ultimate Protection Decking Stain provides comprehensive defence for outdoor timber decking, ensuring longevity and durability against the elements. This high-performance charcoal decking stain is perfect for revitalising garden decking and patio areas, offering significant wear and tear resistance. The water-based formula is touch-dry in just 90 minutes and becomes rainproof rapidly, allowing for efficient project completion. It delivers a hard-wearing, anti-slip finish, protecting against scuffs and scratches, making outdoor surfaces safer and more resilient for everyday use. A 2.5Ltr tin offers excellent coverage for most decking refurbishment jobs.
